units.source_text: 你这胡思妄想，岂可随便乱道！”

en.t: How can you carelessly say such wild, groundless things!"

units.source_text: 两人都觉得此事麻烦，不便再谈下去，话头就转向别处。

en.t: Both of them felt the matter was troublesome and awkward to keep discussing, so the conversation turned elsewhere.
Before long, they parted and each returned home.
